defs.d: To stir the emotions of.
defs.ex: The fireworks which opened the festivities excited anyone present.

defs.d: To arouse or bring out (e.g. feelings); to stimulate.
defs.ex: Favoritism tends to excite jealousy in the ones not being favored.

defs.d: The process of something becoming excited; excitation.
Creating or producing excitement
The part of the forelimb below the forearm or wrist in a human, and the corresponding part in many other animals.
defs.ex: Her hands are really strong.

defs.d: That which resembles, or to some extent performs the office of, a human hand.
To give, pass, or transmit with the hand, literally or figuratively.
defs.ex: He handed them the letter.   She handed responsibility over to her deputy.

defs.d: To lead, guide, or assist with the hand; to conduct.
defs.ex: to hand a lady into a carriage

defs.d: (usually in phrases such as 'from the off', 'at the off', etc.) Beginning; starting point.
defs.ex: He has been very obviously an untrustworthy narrator right from the off.

defs.d: To kill.
defs.ex: He got in the way so I had him offed.

defs.d: To switch off.
defs.ex: Can you off the light?

defs.d: Inoperative, disabled.
defs.ex: All the lights are off.

defs.d: Cancelled; not happening.
defs.ex: The party's off because the hostess is sick.

defs.d: A knitted jacket or jersey, usually of thick wool, worn by athletes before or after exercise.
A similar garment worn for warmth.
To dress in a sweater.
In all likelihood.
A commercial solicitation designed to sell some commodity, service or similar.
defs.ex: Companies try to sell their products using advertisements in form of placards, television spots and print publications.

defs.d: A public notice.
defs.ex: The city council placed an advertisement in the local newspaper to inform its residents of the forthcoming roadworks.

defs.d: The result of copying; an identical duplicate of an original.
defs.ex: Please bring me the copies of those reports.

defs.d: An imitation, sometimes of inferior quality.
defs.ex: That handbag is a copy. You can tell because the buckle is different.

defs.d: To produce an object identical to a given object.
defs.ex: Please copy these reports for me.

defs.d: To give or transmit a copy to (a person).
defs.ex: Make sure you copy me on that important memo.

defs.d: A medical doctor who specializes in dentistry.
A place or institution of confinement, especially of long-term confinement for those convicted of serious crimes or otherwise considered undesirable by the government.
defs.ex: The cold stone walls of the prison had stood for over a century.

defs.d: Confinement in prison.
defs.ex: Prison was a harrowing experience for him.

defs.d: To imprison.
To line or finish (a surface, such as a wall), with plaster, stucco, thin boards, or similar.
To set a higher bound.
The overhead closure of a room.
defs.ex: the dining room had an ornate ceiling

defs.d: The upper limit of an object or action.
The person or thing in the third position.
defs.ex: Jones came in third.

defs.d: One of three equal parts of a whole.
defs.ex: He ate a third of the pie. Divided by two-thirds.

defs.d: To agree with a proposition or statement after it has already been seconded.
To divide into three equal parts.
The ordinal form of the cardinal number three; Coming after the second.
defs.ex: The third tree from the left is my favorite.

defs.d: The act of comparing or the state or process of being compared.
defs.ex: to bring a thing into comparison with another;  there is no comparison between them

defs.d: An evaluation of the similarities and differences of one or more things relative to some other or each-other.
defs.ex: He made a careful comparison of the available products before buying anything.

defs.d: A device used to power electric devices, consisting of a set of electrically connected electrochemical or, archaically, electrostatic cells. A single such cell when used by itself.
The infliction of unlawful physical violence on a person, legally distinguished from assault, which includes the threat of impending violence.
Something brought in from an exterior source, especially for sale or trade.
The practice of importing.
To bring (something) in from a foreign country, especially for sale or trade.
To load a file into a software application from another version or system.
defs.ex: How can I import files from older versions of this application?

defs.d: To instruct or train
defs.ex: Wang said such changes to the Baishui glacier provide the chance to educate visitors about global warming.

defs.d: A person's internal state of being and involuntary physiological response to an object or a situation, based on or tied to physical state and sensory data.
A reaction by a non-human organism with behavioral and physiological elements similar to a person's response.
A diary or daily record of a person, organization, vessel etc.; daybook.
A newspaper or magazine dealing with a particular subject.
defs.ex: The university's biology department subscribes to half a dozen academic journals.

defs.d: To archive or record something.
To scrapbook.
Daily.
Frequent repetition of the same behavior; way of behavior common to many; ordinary manner; habitual practice; method of doing, living or behaving.
Traditional beliefs or rituals
defs.ex: The Ancient Egyptian culture had many distinctive and interesting beliefs and customs.

defs.d: To make familiar; to accustom.
To supply with customers.
Created under particular specifications, specially to fit one's needs: specialized, unique, custom-made
defs.ex: My feet are very large, so I need custom shoes.

defs.d: Own, personal, not standard or premade
defs.ex: We can embroider a wide range of ready designs or a custom logo.

defs.d: An increase in size, number, value, or strength.
defs.ex: Growth was dampened by a softening of the global economy in 2001, but picked up in the subsequent years due to strong growth in China.

defs.d: The act of growing, getting bigger or higher.
A substance in the fundamental state of matter that retains its size and shape without need of a container (as opposed to a liquid or gas).
A three-dimensional figure (as opposed to a surface, an area, or a curve).
(of an object or substance) That can be picked up or held, having a texture, and usually firm. Unlike a liquid or a gas.
defs.ex: Almost all metals are solid at room temperature.

defs.d: Large in size, quantity, or value.
Solidly.
Without spaces or hyphens.
defs.ex: Many long-established compounds are set solid.

defs.d: The soul of a person or other creature. What moves through experience into self-definition as souls purpose.
A supernatural being, often but not exclusively without physical form; ghost, fairy, angel.
defs.ex: A wandering spirit haunts the island.

defs.d: To carry off, especially in haste, secrecy, or mystery.
To animate with vigor; to excite; to encourage; to inspirit; sometimes followed by up.
defs.ex: Civil dissensions often spirit the ambition of private men.

defs.d: A soldier of the lowest rank in the army.
A doctor working in privately rather than publicly funded health care.
Belonging to, concerning, or accessible only to an individual person or a specific group.
defs.ex: Her address is private; you can't have it.

defs.d: Not accessible by the public.
defs.ex: private property

defs.d: In a close manner.
defs.ex: Finnish and Estonian are closely related languages.

defs.d: Secretly; privately
A type, species, or strain of bacterium.
A derisive term for a lowlife or a slob (could be treated as plural or singular).
A single celled organism with cell walls but no nucleus or organelles.
Money one earns by working or by capitalising on the work of others.
Money coming in to a fund, account, or policy.
The state of being a minor; youth, the period of a person's life prior to reaching adulthood.
Any subgroup that does not form a numerical majority.
defs.ex: Most people agreed, but a sizable minority were upset by the decision.

defs.d: Of or relating to a minority.
defs.ex: They hold a minority interest in the company.

defs.d: The movement of a vessel from land into the water; especially, the sliding on ways from the stocks on which it is built. (Compare: to splash a ship.)
The act or fact of launching (a ship/vessel, a project, a new book, etc.).
To throw (a projectile such as a lance, dart or ball); to hurl; to propel with force.
To pierce with, or as with, a lance.
A building, wing or dependency set apart and adapted for lodging and feeding (and training) animals with hoofs, especially horses.
defs.ex: There were stalls for fourteen horses in the squire's stables.

defs.d: (metonymy) All the racehorses of a particular stable, i.e. belonging to a given owner.
To put or keep (an animal) in a stable.
To dwell in a stable.
(interrogative) What person or people; which person or people.
(relative) Used to refer to a previously mentioned person or people.
defs.ex: He's a person with whom I work. (defining)

defs.d: The acquisition of title to, or property in, anything for a price; buying for money or its equivalent.
defs.ex: They offer a free hamburger with the purchase of a drink.

defs.d: That which is obtained, got or acquired, in any manner, honestly or dishonestly; property; possession; acquisition.
To buy, obtain by payment of a price in money or its equivalent.
defs.ex: to purchase land, to purchase a house

defs.d: To pursue and obtain; to acquire by seeking; to gain, obtain, or acquire.
